name: AIA Settings · contextual UX
data: Fictional examples only. Methodology structure (modules, groups, steps, values, formulas, tests, provenance) is extracted from the repo fixture into methodology-data.js; versions, people, studies and events are fictional.

foundation.tokens: tokens/tokens.css light + [data-theme=dark], copied verbatim into the DC helmet
foundation.aiAccent: --ai #a3319a / --ai-ink #8a2783 (dark --ai #e07ad6); not used for settings controls, which use --signal

shell: Settings navigation grouped by purpose (vertical >=1024px, horizontal scroller below)
Tab header: h1, purpose, scope/ownership facts
hierarchy.rule: At most two side columns (app sidebar + settings nav). Choosers inside tabs are inline grids or selects, never a third sidebar.

methodology.hierarchy: module.groups → group.step_ids → step.values (child variables) + step.formulas (expert slots)
methodology.blockPicker: Select with optgroup per group, prev/next buttons, position text; option labels show change and problem counts
block: fields: label [unit], input, original value, changed marker, problem, technical reference (details)
Pro experty (details): formula slots + variables, provenance (implements, SHA-256, evidence), tests
methodology.readOnlyModules: Values rendered as output elements; no edit, save or activate controls; note says changes happen only in code
methodology.draft: Per module; persisted in localStorage; survives block, module and tab changes; replacing a dirty draft (edit from version, discard) needs explicit confirmation
methodology.changedCount: values + formula slots differing from the draft's start
methodology.validation: Local parse errors first (number, boolean, JSON), then server check; problems shown at the field and in a summary whose links select the block and focus the field
methodology.invalidation: Any edit clears check and comparison results
methodology.compare: Shown only after the server returns; lists metrics that moved on fixed fictional panels; states it does not attribute causes
methodology.save: Check + store as a new immutable version (name preset+eN); does not activate
methodology.activate: Separate action per version or reset to preset; reason required; applies to runs started afterwards; existing runs keep their pinned methodology; locked while editing
methodology.history: Activation log with person, time, reason

tabs.prompts: Search + filter, agent chooser grid grouped by family; cards for active / working / stored; full prompt text editable for editors, read-only for locked prompts and members; save creates a version, activation is separate with confirmation; every version keeps its full text and declaration; data-class approval explained
tabs.deep_research: Readiness list linking to missing required rules; search + status filter; rules grouped by category with effective value and origin (approved eN / proposed default) and proposals; detail: versions, approve with reason, propose with validation (lower-only caps, https source), history
tabs.ai: Deployment configuration read-only; states that a switch is not a verified connection or grant
tabs.access: Members with role and server-evaluated approval eligibility; client state; scoped approvals with scope and expiry
tabs.studies: Client/study search; budget, spent, reserved, remaining; unknown cost shown as 'neznámé', never 0; budget validation (not below spent) and save outcome
tabs.audit: Filters: person, event type, reason text; readable sentences; technical JSON in details; read-only
tabs.reference: Purpose search; ownership (Invariant v kódu / Nasazení / Organizace) and where it changes; no switches

states.error: HTTP 504 alert with explicit Zkusit znovu; drafts kept
states.busy: Action buttons disabled while a request is pending; label shows progress verb; no duplicate submission
states.saveFailure: First save attempt fails (serverScenario=saveFails); message keeps the draft and offers explicit retry
states.refused: 403 from server (serverScenario=refused); nothing changes; no retry offered
states.readOnlyRole: role=member: no edit/save/activate/approve controls; content readable
states.guard: Inline alertdialog before discarding a dirty draft

accessibility.focus: Global :focus-visible outline; tab change focuses h1; module change focuses module heading; problem links focus the field
accessibility.keyboard: Native buttons, selects and links in DOM order; Enter submits forms; no custom key traps
accessibility.live: role=status for counts, saves and checks; role=alert for errors
accessibility.reducedMotion: No animation; transitions disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

responsive.1440: Sidebar + vertical settings nav + content max 1180px
responsive.768: No app sidebar; horizontal grouped settings nav; grids wrap
responsive.390: 16px padding; single column; tables scroll horizontally

timing.local: < 400 ms for navigation, chooser, block switch, validation
timing.server: check 700 ms, compare 900 ms, save 700–900 ms, activate 700 ms; always shown as pending until the response
